item.title: New videos show Alex Pretti scuffle with federal officers in Minneapolis 11 days before his death
item.description: Videos show Alex Pretti was forcefully taken to the ground by federal immigration agents after kicking out the tail light of their vehicle during a Minneapolis protest 11 days before he was shot and killed by Border Patrol officers.

item.title: Julius Randle scores 31 points as Timberwolves beat short-handed Mavericks, 118-105
item.description: Julius Randle scored 31 points, Naz Reid added 23 and the Minnesota Timberwolves beat the short-handed Dallas Mavericks 118-105.

item.title: Bangladesh's ousted leader Hasina denounces the upcoming election from her exile in India
item.description: Bangladesh's ousted leader Sheikh Hasina has slammed the country's upcoming election after her party was barred from the polls, remarks that could deepen tensions ahead of the pivotal vote next month.

item.title: Thomas Haugh and Rueben Chinyelu lead No. 19 Florida to 95-48 win over South Carolina
item.description: Thomas Haugh scored 18 points, Rueben Chinyelu had 14 points and 11 rebounds, and No. 19 Florida pounded South Carolina 95-48.

item.title: ASEAN does not recognize military-ruled Myanmar's elections, top Philippine diplomat says
item.description: The Philippine foreign secretary says the Association of Southeast Asian Nations does not recognize the recently held elections in Myanmar, the first since the army seized power in 2021.

item.title: Golden State buries Utah 140-124 behind a flurry of 3-pointers
item.description: Stephen Curry scored 27 points, Moses Moody added 26 and the Golden State Warriors beat the Utah Jazz 140-124 on Wednesday night.

item.title: Blackwell scores 23, including Wisconsin's final 7 points, and Badgers rally past Minnesota 67-63
item.description: John Blackwell scored 23 points, including Wisconsin's last seven points in the final minute, and the Badgers rallied to defeat short-handed Minnesota 67-63.

item.title: Reneau, Donaldson lead Miami over Stanford 79-70
item.description: Malik Reneau scores 20 points and Tre Donaldson adds 18 as Miami beats Stanford 79-70 on Wednesday night.

item.title: Top freshman Kingston Flemings scores 25, Emanuel Sharp has 23 as No. 10 Houston beats TCU 79-70
item.description: Houston freshman Kingston Flemings scored 25 points, Emanuel Sharp had 23 and the 10th-ranked Cougars won 79-70 at TCU.

item.title: Britta Curl-Salemme scores 2 goals, Frost beat Goldeneyes 4-1
item.description: Britta Curl-Salemme had two goals, rookie Kendall Cooper scored her first career goal, and the Minnesota Frost beat the Vancouver Goldeneyes 4-1 in the final game before the PWHL's Olympic break.
